cumleler: Is hearing a sound enough to understand it?
Hearing is necessary but not enough; Erber described it in levels.
Detection is noticing whether a sound is present.
Discrimination is telling whether two sounds are the same or different.
Identification is naming a word or pointing to it among choices.
The top level is comprehension: responding to what the words mean.
